_meta.note: 関税（VAT/GSTとは別物）の国別ルール（E5）。limit は『これ以下なら関税がかからない』現地通貨の額（null は免税枠なし）。above は枠を超えたときの趣味の品の関税。確認できなかった税率は rateCheckedEn を null にして『確認していない』と書く。総額の計算には入れていない（米国と同じく、品目で税率が決まるため）
_meta.limitBasis: 各国とも『荷物の価値』で判定。送料を含むかは国で違うので、本文では商品代だけで目安を出し、その旨を書く

US.summaryEn: No duty-free limit. Goods made in Japan pay 12.5% where the normal duty is lower; books, CDs and other informational materials are exempt.
US.rateCheckedEn: 12.5% on figures, model kits, cards and consoles made in Japan

GB.summaryEn: No customs duty on consignments of £135 or less (VAT still applies). Above that, the UK Global Tariff applies.
GB.rateCheckedEn: Toys and figures 0% to 4%, 0% for goods made in Japan when the UK–Japan preference is claimed; books and game consoles 0%; plastic ornaments such as acrylic stands 6%

rates.what: Dolls representing human beings, other than folk costume dolls (9503 00 21 90)

GB.noteEn: The Japan rate is a preference: it applies only to goods made in Japan, and only when origin is claimed on the import. A figure made in China pays the standard rate.

sources.labelEn: UK Trade Tariff (GOV.UK), commodity codes as listed

DE.summaryEn: The €150 duty-free limit ended on 1 July 2026. Distance sales of €150 or less now pay a flat €3 per declared item line until 1 July 2028; above €150, normal EU tariff rates.
DE.quoteEn: The 3 € fee is applied per declared item, where 'item' means each unit of a product that is declared on a separate line.
DE.caveatEn: The European Commission describes it as applying to distance sales to consumers. Whether a parcel sent on by a proxy counts as one is not something the notice addresses.

sources.labelEn: European Commission, Access2Markets: EU applies €3 customs duty per item on low-value e-commerce consignments

AU.summaryEn: Goods of A$1,000 or less clear without an import declaration and generally without duty; since July 2018 GST on them is collected at the point of sale instead. Above A$1,000, an import declaration is assessed for duty and GST.
AU.quoteEn: Payment of duty and GST is applicable for imported goods with a value exceeding A$1000 unless a concession or exemption applies.

sources.labelEn: Australian Customs fact sheet, Buying on the internet (December 2011)
Department of Home Affairs Notice 2018/14, GST on low value imported goods

CA.summaryEn: Mail worth CAN$20 or less is free of duty and taxes. Above that, duty and sales tax are charged on delivery, and Canada Post adds a CAN$9.95 handling fee.
CA.quoteEn: To process goods imported as mail that are subject to duty and/or tax, the CPC charges the recipient a $9.95 handling fee.

sources.labelEn: CBSA Memorandum D5-1-1, International mail processing (21 October 2024)

SG.summaryEn: No customs duty on hobby goods at all. Singapore only charges duty on intoxicating liquors, tobacco, motor vehicles, and petroleum products and biodiesel blends; everything else pays GST only.
SG.rateCheckedEn: None on figures, books, cards or consoles

sources.labelEn: Singapore Customs, Duties and dutiable goods

SG.quoteEn: Goods not subject to customs or excise duty are non-dutiable, although GST may still apply unless exempted.

TW.summaryEn: Parcels with a customs value of NT$2,000 or less pay no duty or business tax. Above that, duty by tariff heading plus 5% business tax.
TW.quoteEn: If the Customs value is within NT$2,000, the Customs duty, commodity tax and business tax are exempted, except tobacco, alcohol, agricultural products subject to tariff quota.

HK.summaryEn: No duty on anything but liquor, tobacco, hydrocarbon oil and methyl alcohol.
HK.rateCheckedEn: None on figures, books, cards or consoles
